titlestmt.titleproper: A Guide to the Leon Levy Foundation records FA874

profiledesc.creation: This finding aid was produced using ArchivesSpace on 2026-09-02 22:10:38 UTC.
profiledesc.langusage: Description is written in: English, Latin script.

physdesc.extent: 186 containers: 179 letter document boxes, 2 legal document boxes, 2 18 x 14 oversize document boxes (tall), 2 small flat files folders, 1 large flat file folder.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: The collection was donated to RAC by the Leon Levy Foundation in 2023 and 2024.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The Leon Levy Foundation records are arranged in series that reflect the functions and activities of the Leon Levy Foundation. These series are largely based off the original order.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Leon Levy Foundation records consist of grants, program files, meeting minutes, correspondence, and architectural drawings. The records primarily document grants awarded by the Foundation as well as fellowships, nature preserves, archaeological excavations, and other projects that were organized and funded by the Leon Levy Foundation.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open with select materials restricted as noted.
RAC provides an access surrogate of digital media and born-digital files, not the original files. To request an access surrogate be made, please contact a RAC archivist.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: RAC holds legal title. The Leon Levy Foundation retains all applicable intellectual property rights in so far as it holds them.

The Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish material from the collection. Permission to reproduce material in its entirety will be referred to the Leon Levy Foundation.
